======================================================================
  WA CHAT EXPORTER — Installation Guide
  Panduan Instalasi
======================================================================


██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████
  ENGLISH
██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████

WHAT YOU NEED:
  - Google Chrome browser installed
  - The WhatsApp account logged in on your phone (for QR scan)

── WINDOWS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  HOW TO INSTALL (2 steps):

    Step 1 — Double-click "install.bat"

    Step 2 — If Chrome is open, close ALL Chrome windows, then
             press ENTER in the black window that appears.

    Done! Open Chrome — the extension is ready.

  HOW TO UNINSTALL:

    Step 1 — Double-click "uninstall.bat"
    Step 2 — Close Chrome, reopen — the extension is removed.

── MAC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  HOW TO INSTALL (2 steps):

    Step 1 — Double-click "install.command"

    Step 2 — If Chrome is open, quit Chrome (Cmd+Q), then
             press ENTER in the Terminal window that appears.

    Done! Open Chrome — the extension is ready.

  HOW TO UNINSTALL:

    Step 1 — Open Terminal, drag "uninstall.sh" into it, press Enter
    Step 2 — Close Chrome, reopen — the extension is removed.

── TROUBLESHOOTING ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  If the green dot icon doesn't appear in the toolbar:
    - Click the puzzle icon 🧩 (Extensions) in Chrome's top-right
    - Find "WA Chat Exporter" and click the pin 📌 icon

  QUESTIONS? Contact your IT team or supervisor for help.


██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████
  BAHASA INDONESIA
██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████

YANG DIBUTUHKAN:
  - Google Chrome sudah terpasang
  - Akun WhatsApp sudah login di ponsel Anda (untuk pindai QR)

── WINDOWS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  CARA INSTAL (2 langkah):

    Langkah 1 — Klik dua kali "install.bat"

    Langkah 2 — Jika Chrome terbuka, TUTUP SEMUA jendela Chrome,
                lalu tekan ENTER di jendela hitam yang muncul.

    Selesai! Buka Chrome — ekstensi sudah siap.

  CARA MENGHAPUS:

    Langkah 1 — Klik dua kali "uninstall.bat"
    Langkah 2 — Tutup Chrome, buka kembali — ekstensi terhapus.

── MAC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  CARA INSTAL (2 langkah):

    Langkah 1 — Klik dua kali "install.command"

    Langkah 2 — Jika Chrome terbuka, tutup Chrome (Cmd+Q), lalu
                tekan ENTER di jendela Terminal yang muncul.

    Selesai! Buka Chrome — ekstensi sudah siap.

  CARA MENGHAPUS:

    Langkah 1 — Buka Terminal, seret "uninstall.sh" ke dalamnya, tekan Enter
    Langkah 2 — Tutup Chrome, buka kembali — ekstensi terhapus.

── MENGATASI MASALAH ────────────────────────────────────────────

  Jika ikon bulat hijau tidak muncul di toolbar:
    - Klik ikon puzzle 🧩 (Extensions) di kanan atas Chrome
    - Cari "WA Chat Exporter" dan klik pin 📌

  PERTANYAAN? Hubungi tim IT atau supervisor Anda.
